operative_text.controlling:
10.55   Nothing in these rules prevents or is to be interpreted as
preventing the Court, as a superior court, from exercising its
inherent power to cite in contempt and punish those who disobey
the Court’s lawful orders or who otherwise display contempt for its
process.

Book A prints the same list in the Part 11 opening (combined_rule11.txt lines 26-30, with 'judgment centre' where Book C prints 'judicial centre'; the Appendix defines 'judicial centre', official line 40855), while Book A's Part 10 list (combined_rule10.txt lines 35-40: assessment officer; claim; client; commencement document; contingency fee agreement; costs award; ...; trustee) is a different list. The note ends with 'G P ENERAL ROVISIONS', the heading 'GENERAL PROVISIONS' (Division 1 of Part 11) with its drop-cap letters separated. The note is kept here as printed by Book C, attached to the last rule of Part 10 in its file, and belongs to Part 11.
